sys_script_client.description: This Client Script prevents users from submitting an Incident record with Priority = 1 if the Short Description field is empty. It ensures that all critical incidents have a clear Short Description before being saved to the database.
sys_script_client.messages: g_form.addErrorMessage("⚠️ Short Description is required for Priority 1 incidents.");
sys_script_client.name: NeedIt onSubmit Example
